title: hexToFigmaRgb
description: Converts a CSS HEX color string into the Figma solid-paint RGB format with channels in the 0–1 range.

params.name: hex
params.description: HEX color, with or without a leading # (e.g. '#0C8CE9' or '0C8CE9').

returns.description: Object `{ r, g, b }` with each channel in [0, 1].
